%   gov_deconcentration.csv (modified 2026-10-14 20:11): all rows (budget fraction x alpha grid per tissue); chosen = primary label-free rule; chosen_pielou = post hoc
\textbf{Label-free deconcentration of the promoted set.} Each line is one budget (share of the promoted pool, colour) traced over the TF penalty $\lambda \in \{0, 0.25, 0.5, 1, 2, 4, 8, 16\}$; x: TF diversity (Shannon entropy over TFs divided by the log number of TFs in the pool), y: mean credibility of the selected subset (min of global-fit and context-fit credibility). Star: operating point chosen by the label-free rule of Section~\ref{sec:governance} (harmonic mean of normalised credibility and diversity; fixed after held-out results of other analyses existed, but no held-out data enter the choice); open square: the same budget without penalty; open diamond: the post hoc variant with Pielou evenness.
